datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Cameroon during 2021, collecting IPC classification data at the geographic/administrative level. Data were compiled into monthly medium-term projection datasets with multiple scenarios, georeferenced as polygon features with classification phases and metadata attributes.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys, providing geographic classifications of acute food insecurity severity across administrative areas.
